display_long_description:
**A VR RHYTHM GAME BUILT ON TIMING, MOVEMENT, AND MOMENTUM**

Peak Rhythm is a high-intensity **VR rhythm game** where you climb by moving in sync with the music. Designed for fans **of music games, multiplayer VR, and fitness gameplay**, every run tests your timing, focus, and endurance.

Climb through a neon cyberpunk city by **landing each grab in rhythm**. Every correctly timed movement builds speed. Stay on beat to accelerate. Fall out of rhythm and lose momentum.


[media]

# 🕹️**FEATURES**
- **Rhythm-Based Climbing** - Time your grabs, twists, and jumps to stay in sync and maintain flow
- **Momentum Driven Gameplay** - 
 Accurate timing increases speed and keeps your climb alive
- **Solo Play + Global Leaderboards** - 
 Climb 7 original tracks across 3 difficulty levels and compete for the highest run
- **Multiplayer (Up to 4 Players)** - 
 Climb alongside friends or compete in real time
- **Electronic Soundtrack** - 
 Drum and Bass, Dubstep, and House tracks designed for flow
- **Custom Songs & Beatmaps** - 
Create and play your own levels with your own music
- **Avatar Customization**

[media]

# 🏁 **BUILT FOR VR FITNESS & REPLAYABILITY**
Full-body movement designed for active gameplay
Improve coordination, timing, and endurance
High replay value through score chasing and user content

# 🚀 **EARLY ACCESS**
Planned updates include:
- More songs
- Voice chat
- Cross-platform play

**CLIMB FASTER. MOVE SHARPER. STAY IN RHYTHM.**

Join our community to help shape the future of Peak Rhythm!


**[Discord Link: https://discord.gg/RZuzxpRcyV]**
